```{r}
library(esr)
set.seed(42)
X <- matrix(rnorm(200), 40, 5)
y <- X %*% c(2, -1, 0.5, 0, 0) + rnorm(40)
mod <- ridge(X, y)
print(mod)
plot(mod)
head(predict(mod, X))
```
